summary_1line: Adhiratha and Radha discover the radiant infant Karna in a river basket, adopt him, and he grows into a famed warrior allied with Duryodhana.

image_candidates.scene_text: A wooden box drifts along the Ganga as Adhiratha and the beautiful Radha pull it from the water and open it to reveal a radiant infant wearing golden armor and earrings.
Radha cradles the sun-bright infant Karna in her arms on the riverbank while Adhiratha looks on in astonishment.
At midday beside a river, Karna stands with folded hands worshipping the blazing Sun while Brahmanas gather around to ask for gifts.
